name: Great Planes Millwork
old_description: Elevating Spaces with Reproduction Molding & Fine Woodworking
about:
Great Planes Millwork operates from Nevada, Iowa, where founder Luke Ulrich began his woodworking journey in the early 1990s. After years of study and participation in woodworking clubs in Des Moines and Ames, Ulrich established a workshop focused on handcrafted solid-wood pieces.

The shop specializes in reproduction moulding that matches historic architectural profiles, custom furniture and cabinets, end-grain cutting boards, and a range of one-off wooden items such as display easels, picture frames, and golf-ball display cases. Each piece starts with hand-selected hardwoods and moves through a milling process overseen directly by Ulrich.

The customer base is primarily residential, including homeowners seeking to restore period details or commission heirloom-quality furniture. Testimonials reference projects like matching existing crown moulding in a home and building a custom golf-ball display cabinet for a family.

Ulrich emphasizes that the business avoids mass production; every item is made by hand with a collaborative design phase that puts the client at the center. The company stands behind its work with a satisfaction guarantee, citing passion and attention to detail as its defining traits.
